analysis: Any timezone-aware timestamp; use only completed and available bars. Primary scheduled replay includes 08:55:30 ET premarket; arbitrary timestamps use the same feature function.
entry: First five-minute bar start strictly after decision_at + 30 seconds, inside 04:00-15:30 ET and before official close. No entry using the decision bar's open/high.
take_profit: Attach a GTC regular-session sell-limit intent when the entry fills, at ceil(actual raw entry fill * 1.05 * 100)/100. The attached order is active at the next regular-session bar; no favorable gap windfall. Extended-hours target fills are not assumed from sparse bars.
holding_limit: 14 calendar days inclusive of entry date. If day 14 is closed, expire at the last official regular-session close on or before it. Unknown/missing prefixes stay unresolved and retain capital.
capital: One position, fractional analytical units, no borrowing, maximum one new entry per ET stock-day and one position per account. Sale proceeds reusable next official session; all months May-September run continuously.
primary_metric: User-confirmed arithmetic mean of the three requested calendar months' net marked-to-market capital-ledger returns, including all wins/losses, costs, dividends and cross-month holdings.
secondary_metrics: entry-month completed-trade attribution including pending counts
selection: For each month, models and policy thresholds use only full 14-day windows matured before the month. Most recent 40 eligible dates are policy selection; all training-label deadlines precede selection start. Minimum 100 training dates and 3 selection trades. Models are not refit on selection. All trials retained.
model_routes: LogisticRegression hit probability + ExtraTrees miss payoff
news: Not required for this first as-of extension; no retrospective news feature is invented.
completion: Runtime and accounting checks plus actual complete requested-month replay mean >= 10%. Engineering checks or a favorable subset alone do not establish completion. Independent prospective effectiveness is reported separately.
